articles.title: DRP 130726: Urge to set up Statutory River Authority
articles.summary: A draft Bill proposes declaring ecological flow as the first priority for river waters, subordinate only to drinking water needs. It also suggests that water released to sustain rivers should no longer be recorded as waste or unutilized. The proposal comes from a draft Bill and aims to address river conservation challenges in India.
articles.raw_summary: One of the significant provisions of the draft Bill is the declaration that ecological flow should become the first charge on river waters, subordinate only to emergency drinking water requirements. The proposal also states that water released to keep rivers alive should no longer be treated as “waste”, “loss” or “unutilised water” in official records.

articles.title: Donald Trump announces 20% toll on ships in Strait of Hormuz; to ‘reinstate’ Iran blockade

articles.title: Retail inflation jumps to 4.38% in June, driven by food, jewellery prices; breaches RBI's 4% target
articles.summary: India's retail inflation increased to 4.38 percent in June from May's 3.93 percent. Higher food prices significantly pushed up the overall Consumer Price Index for the month. Rural areas experienced higher inflation rates than urban centers during this period.
